title: Houston street cut permit

source_citations.reference: Mobility, Street Cut and Excavation Permits Presentation

explanations.trigger_explanation: Excavation, boring, or pavement cutting in Houston public right-of-way likely needs a street cut or excavation permit.

known_unknowns: This pass did not locate a single current codified street-cut ordinance webpage; city-hosted permit guidance was used.
advisories: Additional review is recommended if the work also affects lane closures, traffic control, or Texas Department of Transportation right-of-way.
notes: Tier 3: city-hosted guidance clearly describes the permit trigger, but project-specific submittal mechanics should be confirmed in the live permitting portal.
